title: Webs and Water
description: Clear Spider Hollow or the Drowned Temple.

giver.name: Kestrel Vane
giver.text: Two more lairs, two nightmares. A hollow full of spiders under the dark forest, and a drowned temple under the sea. Clear whichever you dare first.
